name: zainab_personal_bot
cron_timezone_note: UTC expression equivalent to 9:03am Asia/Karachi, once daily
delivery: PDF file, built with Bash inside the routine's own sandbox and sent directly to Zainab via the SendUserFile tool. No MCP connector involved.
delivery_history: Originally Gmail draft delivery; switched to Google Drive because the org's connector policy disables 'always allow' for Gmail, blocking automated/routine use. The Google Drive connector then got stuck pending approval, so delivery was switched to routine run output only (no connector). That output was in a coding-style pipe-table format, hard for a non-coder to read, so it was replaced with a self-generated PDF (plain readable paragraphs, proper formatting) delivered straight to Zainab via SendUserFile — no connector needed at all.
